title: The Fifth Season
author: N. K. Jemisin
summary: On a continent regularly shattered by world-ending seismic disasters, people called orogenes who can move the earth are feared and controlled. Three women of different ages, in three storylines, are each pursuing survival and answers.
readIf: you want a demanding, brilliantly constructed fantasy that blends science fiction and uses a surprising narrative voice.
skipIf: you want comfort or an easy start, as it opens with a child's death and is bleak and confusing at first.

pairings.reason: Another stark story of a young woman with a difference who survives a collapsing world.
Another unsparing fantasy about power, oppression and the price paid by those with dangerous gifts.
Same author's debut, a more accessible, gods-and-politics epic with a livelier voice.
